```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})
setDTthreads(max(1L, as.integer(params$threads)))

# JAX patch: deduplicate binom.test calls on unique (mod, n) pairs — identical
# numerical output but avoids redundant Clopper-Pearson calls on large datasets.
binom_ci_dedup <- function(mod_vec, n_vec, conf = 0.999) {
  pairs <- data.table(mod = mod_vec, n = n_vec)
  unique_pairs <- unique(pairs[n > 0])
  unique_pairs[, `:=`(
    lower_ci = mapply(function(k, n) binom.test(k, n, conf.level = conf)$conf.int[1], mod, n),
    upper_ci = mapply(function(k, n) binom.test(k, n, conf.level = conf)$conf.int[2], mod, n)
  )]
  result <- merge(pairs, unique_pairs, by = c("mod", "n"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  result[is.na(lower_ci), `:=`(lower_ci = 0.0, upper_ci = 0.0)]
  list(lower = result$lower_ci, upper = result$upper_ci)
}

parse_positions_vec <- function(dt, plot_vbias=FALSE) {
  if (plot_vbias) {
    meta_cols <- c("chr", "start", "end", "read_id", "orientation", "insert_size", "flag")
  } else {
    meta_cols <- c("chr", "flag")
  }
  col_types <- list(mod_cpgs="M", unmod_cpgs="U", snp_cpgs="S", mod_denovos="m", unmod_denovos="u")
  n <- nrow(dt)
  parts <- lapply(names(col_types), function(col) {
    splits <- strsplit(as.character(dt[[col]]), ",", fixed=TRUE)
    lens <- lengths(splits)
    pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(unlist(splits, use.names=FALSE)))
    ridx <- rep(seq_len(n), lens)
    keep <- !is.na(pos)
    if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
    data.table(row_idx=ridx[keep], pos_in_read=pos[keep], type=col_types[[col]])
  })
  dt[, (names(col_types)) := NULL]
  gc()
  parts <- Filter(Negate(is.null), parts)
  if (length(parts) == 0) return(dt[integer(0), ..meta_cols])
  result <- rbindlist(parts)
  rm(parts); gc()
  cbind(dt[result$row_idx, ..meta_cols], result[, .(pos_in_read, type)])
}


# For a subset of observations of read orientation on one strand,
# calculate the suggested cutoff points
calculate_cutoff <- function(mbias_table) {
  mbias_table <- mbias_table[order(mbias_table$pos),]
  # get the mean beta of the middle 60% of the data
  n_obs <- nrow(mbias_table)
  if (n_obs < 3) {
    return(data.frame(left = as.double(0), right = as.double(0)))
  }
  upper_lim <- min(ceiling(n_obs * 0.8), n_obs-1)
  lower_lim <- max(floor(n_obs * 0.2), 2)
  mean_middle <- mean(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$beta)
  upper_ci_max <- max(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$upper_ci)
  lower_ci_min <- min(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$lower_ci)

  check_match <- function(row, mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max) {
    if (is.na(mean_middle) || is.null(mean_middle) || is.na(row$beta) || is.null(row$beta) || is.na(lower_ci_min) || is.null(lower_ci_min) || is.na(upper_ci_max) || is.null(upper_ci_max)) {
      return(FALSE)
    }
    if (!row$beta %between% c(lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max)
        && abs(row$beta - mean_middle) > 0.05
        && !mean_middle %between% c(row$lower_ci, row$upper_ci)) {
      return(TRUE)
    }
    return(FALSE)
  }

  left_cutoff = 0
  right_cutoff = 0

  middle = ceiling(n_obs/2)
  for (pos in middle:1) {
    if (check_match(mbias_table[pos,], mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max)) {
      left_cutoff = pos
      break
    }
  }
  for (pos in 1:(n_obs-middle)) {
    if (check_match(mbias_table[middle+pos,], mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max)) {
      right_cutoff = n_obs - (middle+pos) + 1
      break
    }
  }
  return(data.frame(left=as.double(left_cutoff), right=as.double(right_cutoff)))
}
```

```{r transform_data, include=FALSE}
.ts <- function(msg) cat(format(Sys.time(), "[%H:%M:%S]"), " [transform_data] ", msg, "\n", file=stderr(), sep="")

# if no bgz given, but a bam file is provided, generate bed file on the fly
if ((is.na(params$input_bgz) || is.null(params$input_bgz) || nchar(params$input_bgz)==0 || !file.exists(params$input_bgz)) && !is.na(params$input_bam) && !is.null(params$input_bam) && nchar(params$input_bam)>0 && file.exists(params$input_bam)) {
  if (is.na(params$reference) || is.null(params$reference) || nchar(params$reference)==0 || !file.exists(params$reference)) {
    stop("Cannot run from bam file without a reference")
  }

  if (!is.na(params$region) && nchar(params$region) > 0) {
    command=paste(params$rastair, "per-read --bed - -r", params$reference, "-l", params$region, "-f", params$include_flags, "-F", params$exclude_flags, "-@", params$threads, params$input_bam)
  } else {
    command=paste(params$rastair, "per-read --bed - -r", params$reference, "-f", params$include_flags, "-F", params$exclude_flags, "-@", params$threads, params$input_bam)
  }
} else if (!(is.na(params$input_bgz) || is.null(params$input_bgz) || nchar(params$input_bgz)==0 || !file.exists(params$input_bgz))) {
  if (!is.na(params$region) && nchar(params$region) > 0) {
    command=paste(params$tabix, "-h", params$input_bgz, params$region)
  } else {
    command=paste("zcat", params$input_bgz)
  }
}  else {
  stop("Neither per-read bgz nor bam file given, cannot proceed")
}

.ts("loading per-read BED...")
.t0 <- proc.time()
data <- fread(cmd=command, header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
setnames(data, 1, "chr")
data[, chr := as.factor(chr)]
data[, orientation := as.factor(orientation)]
.all_chroms <- levels(data$chr)
.ts(paste0("loaded: ", nrow(data), " reads, ", length(.all_chroms), " chromosomes (", round((proc.time()-.t0)["elapsed"], 1), "s)"))
cat("[transform_data] all chromosomes: ", paste(.all_chroms, collapse=", "), "\n", file=stderr(), sep="")

# Filter to primary chromosomes only (numeric + X/Y, with or without "chr" prefix)
.primary_re <- "^(chr)?([0-9]+|[XY])$"
.primary_chroms <- grep(.primary_re, .all_chroms, value=TRUE)
data <- data[chr %in% .primary_chroms]
data[, chr := droplevels(data$chr)]
.ts(paste0("after primary chr filter: ", nrow(data), " reads, ", length(.primary_chroms), " chromosomes (", paste(.primary_chroms, collapse=", "), ")"))

if (!is.null(params$is_WGBS) && params$is_WGBS == TRUE) {
  data[, num_mod := num_cpg - num_mod] # flip mod/unmod
  setnames(data, c("mod_cpgs", "unmod_cpgs", "mod_denovos", "unmod_denovos"), c("unmod_cpgs", "mod_cpgs", "unmod_denovos", "mod_denovos"))
}

# remove reads without CpGs
data <- data[num_cpg > 0]

# filter by flags
data <- data[bitwAnd(flag, params$include_flags) == params$include_flags]
data <- data[bitwAnd(flag, params$exclude_flags) == 0]
.ts(paste0("after CpG + flag filter: ", nrow(data), " reads"))

if (is.null(params$read_len) || is.na(params$read_len) || !is.numeric(params$read_len)) {
  read_len <- max(data$read_length, na.rm=TRUE)
} else {
  read_len = params$read_len
}

data <- data[, .N, by=.(chr, start, end, read_id, mapq, orientation, insert_size, read_length, flag, mod_cpgs, unmod_cpgs, snp_cpgs, mod_denovos, unmod_denovos)] # unify duplicate reads
.ts(paste0("after dedup: ", nrow(data), " reads"))

# Break comma-separated pos_in_read into a list
.ts("running parse_positions_vec (vectorized)...")
.t0 <- proc.time()
data <- parse_positions_vec(data, plot_vbias=params$plot_vbias)
.ts(paste0("parse_positions done: ", nrow(data), " CpG observations (", round((proc.time()-.t0)["elapsed"], 1), "s)"))

mbias_table <- data[, .(
  mod = sum(type %in% c("M", "m")),
  unmod = sum(type %in% c("U", "u"))
), by = .(
  chr,
  pos = pos_in_read,
  read_pair = as.factor(fifelse(bitwAnd(flag, 64) > 0, "First", "Second")),
  strand = as.factor(fifelse(bitwAnd(flag, 96) == 96 | bitwAnd(flag, 144) == 144, "OT", "OB"))
)]
.ts(paste0("mbias_table built: ", nrow(mbias_table), " (chr x pos x strand x read_pair) rows"))

# Flip the OB reads so that mbias is always reported 5' -> 3'
mbias_table[strand=="OT" & read_pair == "Second" | strand=="OB" & read_pair == "First", pos := read_len-pos]
# JAX patch: use binom_ci_dedup to avoid redundant binom.test calls
mbias_table <- mbias_table[, beta := mod/(mod+unmod)]
.ts("computing binom CIs (deduped)...")
.t0 <- proc.time()
ci <- binom_ci_dedup(mbias_table$mod, mbias_table$mod + mbias_table$unmod)
mbias_table[, lower_ci := ci$lower][, upper_ci := ci$upper]
mbias_table <- mbias_table[, .(beta=first(beta), lower_ci=first(lower_ci), upper_ci=first(upper_ci)), by=.(chr, pos, read_pair, strand)]
mbias_table <- mbias_table[!is.na(beta)]
setkey(mbias_table, chr, pos)
.ts(paste0("binom CIs done (", round((proc.time()-.t0)["elapsed"], 1), "s)"))
.ts(paste0("transform_data done: ", nrow(mbias_table), " rows, ", length(unique(mbias_table$chr)), " chromosomes"))
fwrite(mbias_table[order(chr, as.integer(pos), read_pair, strand)], file.path(params$output_dir, "mbias_table.tsv"), sep="\t")
```

## M-bias plots

```{r plot_mbias, echo=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
.chroms <- unique(mbias_table$chr)
.chroms <- .chroms[order(suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^chr", "", as.character(.chroms)))), as.character(.chroms), na.last = TRUE)]
for (.i in seq_along(.chroms)) {
  chrom <- .chroms[.i]
  cat(format(Sys.time(), "[%H:%M:%S]"), " [plot_mbias] chromosome ", chrom, " (", .i, "/", length(.chroms), ")\n", file=stderr(), sep="")
  cutoffs <- mbias_table[chr==chrom, calculate_cutoff(as.data.frame(.SD)), by=.(chr, read_pair, strand)]
  #write cutoffs to file if requested
  if (!is.na(params$output_dir) && !is.null(params$output_dir)) {
    out_table <- cutoffs[, .(l_ot = .SD[read_pair=="First", left],
                             r_ot = .SD[read_pair=="First", right],
                             l_ob = .SD[read_pair=="Second", left],
                             r_ob = .SD[read_pair=="Second", right]),
                         by=strand]
    setDF(out_table)
    out_table <- out_table[order(out_table$strand, decreasing=TRUE), ]  # OT before OB
    write.table(out_table[,2:5], file.path(params$output_dir, paste0(chrom, "_cutoffs.txt")), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=",")
  }

  if (grepl(.primary_re, as.character(chrom))) {
    g <- ggplot(mbias_table[chr==chrom], aes(x=pos, y=beta, color=read_pair)) +
          geom_line() +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower_ci, ymax=upper_ci, fill=read_pair), alpha=0.2) +
          labs(color = "Read") +
          xlab("Position in read (5'->3')") +
          scale_color_discrete(labels=c('First in pair', 'Second in pair')) +
          scale_fill_discrete(guide="none") +
          theme_light()
    if(!is.null(cutoffs)) {
      g = g + geom_vline(aes(xintercept=left, color=read_pair), data=cutoffs)
      g = g + geom_vline(aes(xintercept=read_len-right, color=read_pair), data=cutoffs)
    }
    g = g + facet_wrap(vars(strand), nrow = 2, as.table = FALSE)
    g = g + ggtitle(chrom)
    print(g)
  }
}
```

## V-bias plots

```{r transform_vbias, include=FALSE}
if (params$plot_vbias) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(ggside)
  })

  vdata <- rbindlist(Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(levels(data$chr), function(chrom) {
    cat(format(Sys.time(), "[%H:%M:%S]"), " [transform_vbias] chromosome ", chrom, "\n", file=stderr(), sep="")

    vdata_c <- data[chr == chrom]
    if (nrow(vdata_c) == 0L) return(NULL)

    vdata_c[, Orientation := fifelse(bitwAnd(flag, 96) == 96 | bitwAnd(flag, 144) == 144, "OT", "OB")]
    vdata_c[, abs_pos := start + pos_in_read]

    # Fragment bounds: leftmost start and rightmost end across both paired reads
    frag_bounds <- vdata_c[, .(frag_start = min(start), frag_end = max(end)),
                           by = .(read_id, Orientation)]
    vdata_c <- vdata_c[frag_bounds, on = .(read_id, Orientation)]

    # Distance from 5' end of the fragment: OT counts from left, OB counts from right
    vdata_c[Orientation == "OT", pos_in_fragment := abs_pos - frag_start]
    vdata_c[Orientation == "OB", pos_in_fragment := frag_end - abs_pos]

    # Pre-aggregate to 2D histogram tiles — only biologically valid positions
    vdata_c[pos_in_fragment >= 0L & pos_in_fragment < insert_size, .(
      n_mod   = sum(type == "M"),
      n_total = .N
    ), by = .(chr, pos_in_fragment, insert_size, Orientation)]
  })))
}
```

```{r plot_vbias, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=7, warning=FALSE}
if (params$plot_vbias) {
  for (chrom in unique(vdata$chr)) {

    # vdata is already pre-aggregated (pos_in_fragment < insert_size filtered at build time)
    vdata_plot <- vdata[
      chr == chrom,
      .(beta         = sum(n_mod) / sum(n_total),
        observations = sum(n_total)),
      by = .(`Pos in fragment` = pos_in_fragment,
             `Insert size`     = insert_size,
             Orientation)
    ]

    side_counts <- vdata_plot[
      , .(obs = sum(observations)),
      by = .(`Insert size`, Orientation)
    ]
    side_counts[, obs_pdf:=obs/sum(obs), by=.(Orientation)]

    y_max <- as.numeric(quantile(vdata_plot[["Insert size"]], 0.99,  na.rm = TRUE))
    x_max <- as.numeric(quantile(vdata_plot[["Pos in fragment"]], 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))

    p <- ggplot(vdata_plot, aes(x = `Pos in fragment`, y = `Insert size`, fill = beta)) +
      geom_tile() +

      geom_ysidebar(
        data = side_counts,
        aes(y = `Insert size`, x = obs_pdf),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        stat = "identity",
        orientation = "y"
      ) +
      ggside(y.pos = "left") +

      scale_ysidex_reverse() +

      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "black", mid = "orange", high = "purple", midpoint = 0.5) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 600), expand = c(0, 0)) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 600), expand = c(0, 0)) +

      ggtitle(chrom) +
      facet_wrap(vars(Orientation)) +

      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        ggside.panel.grid = element_blank(),
        ggside.axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        ggside.axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        ggside.axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
      )

    print(p)
  }
  rm(vdata, data)
  invisible({gc()})
}
```

## CpG/GC bias

```{r parse_per_pos, include=FALSE}
if (params$plot_gc) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Rsamtools)
    library(Biostrings)
  })

  if ((is.na(params$input_vcf) || is.null(params$input_vcf) || !file.exists(params$input_vcf)) && !is.na(params$input_bam) && !is.null(params$input_bam) && file.exists(params$input_bam)) {
    if (!is.na(params$region) && nchar(params$region) > 0) {
      command <- paste(params$rastair,
    		"call -@", params$threads,
    		"-l", params$region,
    		"--vcf-info-fields SC5,CPG,CPGnovo --vcf-format-fields GT,DP,M5mC --vcf - -c",
    		"-r", params$reference,
    		params$input_bam,
    		"|", params$bcftools, "norm -m-any",
    		"|", params$bcftools, "query -f \"%CHROM\\t%POS\\t%REF\\t%ALT\\t%CPGnovo[\\t%TGT\\t%DP\\t%M5mC]\\n\"")
    } else {
      command <- paste(params$rastair,
    		"call -@", params$threads,
    		"--vcf-info-fields SC5,CPG,CPGnovo --vcf-format-fields GT,DP,M5mC --vcf - -c",
    		"-r", params$reference,
    		params$input_bam,
    		"|", params$bcftools, "norm -m-any",
    		"|", params$bcftools, "query -f \"%CHROM\\t%POS\\t%REF\\t%ALT\\t%CPGnovo[\\t%TGT\\t%DP\\t%M5mC]\\n\"")
    }
  } else if (!is.na(params$input_vcf) && !is.null(params$input_vcf) && file.exists(params$input_vcf)) {
    if (!is.na(params$region) && nchar(params$region) > 0) {
      command <- paste(params$bcftools,
        "view", params$input_vcf,
        params$region,
        "|", params$bcftools, "norm -m-any",
  		  "|", params$bcftools, "query -f \"%CHROM\\t%POS\\t%REF\\t%ALT\\t%CPGnovo[\\t%TGT\\t%DP\\t%M5mC]\\n\"")
    } else {
      command <- paste(params$bcftools,
        "norm -m-any", params$input_vcf,
  		  "|", params$bcftools, "query -f \"%CHROM\\t%POS\\t%REF\\t%ALT\\t%CPGnovo[\\t%TGT\\t%DP\\t%M5mC]\\n\"")
    }
  } else {
    stop("Need either vcf or bam file to create gc bias plot")
  }

	all_calls <- fread(cmd=command,
		stringsAsFactors=FALSE,
		header=FALSE)
	setnames(all_calls, c("chr", "pos", "ref", "alt", "isDN", "genotype", "depth", "beta"))
	all_calls[grepl(",", beta, fixed=TRUE), beta := tstrsplit(beta, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]]]
	all_calls[, beta := as.numeric(beta)]
	all_calls[, `:=`(chr = as.factor(chr), ref=as.factor(ref), alt=as.factor(alt), genotype=as.factor(genotype))]

	if (!is.null(params$is_WGBS) && params$is_WGBS == TRUE) {
    all_calls[, beta := 1-beta]
  }
	site_windows <- all_calls[, .N, by=.(chr = as.character(chr), pos = as.integer(pos))]
  site_windows <- site_windows[order(chr, pos)]

  fa <- FaFile(params$reference)
  open(fa)
  on.exit(close(fa), add = TRUE)

  chrom_lengths <- seqlengths(fa)
  missing_chroms <- setdiff(unique(site_windows$chr), names(chrom_lengths))
  if (length(missing_chroms) > 0) {
    stop("Chromosome(s) missing from reference FASTA: ", paste(missing_chroms, collapse = ", "))
  }

  site_windows[, window_start := pmax(1L, pos - 50L)]
  site_windows[, window_end := pmin(as.integer(chrom_lengths[chr]), pos + 50L)]

  gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = site_windows$chr,
    ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = site_windows$window_start, end = site_windows$window_end)
  )

  seqs <- scanFa(fa, param = gr)
  base_counts <- alphabetFrequency(seqs, baseOnly = TRUE)[, c("A", "C", "G", "T"), drop = FALSE]

  site_windows[, gc_count := base_counts[, "G"] + base_counts[, "C"]]
  site_windows[, at_count := base_counts[, "A"] + base_counts[, "T"]]
  site_windows[, cpg_count := as.integer(vcountPattern("CG", seqs, fixed = TRUE))]
  site_windows[, window_width := window_end - window_start + 1L]
  rm(seqs)
  site_windows[, chr := factor(chr, levels = levels(all_calls$chr))]
  all_calls[site_windows, on = .(chr, pos), `:=`(
    gc_count = i.gc_count,
    at_count = i.at_count,
    cpg_count = i.cpg_count,
    window_start = i.window_start,
    window_end = i.window_end,
    window_width = i.window_width
  )]
}
```
